prompt: A PMS and channel manager could co-author a booking-operations guide and host a webinar; define each partner's promotion commitment and separate opt-ins for follow-up. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Score partners on audience fit, complementary value, execution capacity and mutual benefit. Choose a small joint deliverable with a distribution plan and named responsibilities. Agree attribution, brand review, lead ownership, consent, budget and exit terms before launch. Use aggregate fit estimates rather than exchanging identifiable customer lists.

Track qualified participants, accepted leads, opportunities and partner contribution, with a post-campaign review against agreed commitments. Test registration and consent handling.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
